ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, manager, director, authorized signatory and nominee against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Egyptian Terrorist Persons and Entities List, and global PEP databases. PEPs require enhanced due diligence including source of wealth confirmation, senior-management approval, and continuous monitoring. For digital store publishing, all Steam Valve and PlayStation Store payouts must be monitored for activity inconsistent with declared revenue; any sanctions or PEP hit must be reported within 24 hours to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Combating Terrorism Financing Unit (EMLCU).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) and the Commercial Registry module operated by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official corporate name must be in Arabic; if the desired trade name uses Latin characters (e.g., a PC/console publishing brand), a registered Arabic transliteration is mandatory and must be identical in meaning or transliteration. The Latin script may be adopted as a parallel trade name in the company extract but cannot replace the Arabic statutory name in the Commercial Registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Religious references (e.g., Islamic symbols, Quran, Mosque)
Suez Canal (where no concession or authorization)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the registry rejects the name, the applicant may submit a written administrative objection through GAFI's OSS within 15 calendar days of receiving the rejection, citing the specific statutory basis for registerability. GAFI must rule within 15 working days; if the administrative appeal is dismissed, the applicant may file a judicial appeal before the competent Administrative Court of the Economic Courts under Egyptian administrative litigation rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the registered/administrative address provided a licensed service office or business center is used and there is a real, verifiable operational presence (digital publishing activity, tax registration and adequate bookkeeping). A pure shell virtual office with no office space and no operational substance is not permissible for the stated Steam console publishing scope.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 5–10% unannounced physical inspection likelihood for a low-risk digital publishing LLC; the likelihood materially increases if the registered address is a virtual office, if UBO documentation contains anomalies, or if declared revenue from Steam or PlayStation stores is materially inconsistent with bank statements.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (LLC provisions in Articles 102–107 and 126–127, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2009 and digital transformation amendments of Law No. 194 of 2020), read with Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations, and Commercial Registration Law No. 34 of 1976
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registry and Commercial Registration One-Stop-Shop
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association (Incorporation Contract) authenticated before a Notary Public and filed on Commercial Registration Application Form No. 2 with GAFI
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum issued capital for an LLC is EGP 50,000 (approx. USD 1,600); the paid-up portion must equal at least the 50% statutory minimum or the higher ratio stated in the Memorandum of Association. No mandatory bank escrow account applies to LLCs; the paid-up capital must be credited to the company capital account and evidenced by a bank certificate of deposit before issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate. In-kind contributions require a GAFI-approved auditor valuation report.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board of Directors of the Company, duly convened in accordance with the Memorandum of Association, adopts this First Board Resolution: (1) Share Subscription and Allotment: the subscriptions of all founding shareholders and the paid-up capital contributions reflected in the bank capital account are ratified, approved, and allotted per the Company’s capital schedule; (2) Registered Office: the office at [full address], Cairo, Egypt, is confirmed as the Company’s statutory registered office and official legal seat; (3) Officer Appointments: [Name A] is appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name B] Chief Financial Officer, and [Name C] Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, each authorised to execute filings with GAFI, tax authorities, and regulators; (4) The officers are authorised to complete all incorporation and licensing formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Electronic Name Reservation Portal and One-Stop-Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit through GAFI's online name reservation system or in person at the investor One-Stop-Shop an application providing three alternative corporate names, each containing the LLC suffix /شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة, and evidencing non-conflict with protected trade names, trademarks, or public order. Pay the statutory name reservation fee (approx. EGP 300–500), obtain the Name Reservation Certificate valid for 30 calendar days, and verify the transliterated Arabic name for international Steam/PlayStation commercial registration.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (GAFI Form 1)
Certified copies of national IDs or passports of all shareholders
Memorandum explaining the chosen name if a distinctive or transliterated name is requested
Power of attorney if an agent or legal consultant files on behalf of the shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity, trademark conflict, or non-compliance, GAFI issues a written refusal reason; the applicant may file a reconsideration request within 15 business days, propose another name from the submitted alternatives, or adjust the reference list. Trademark disputes require withdrawal or amendment of the name prior to notarization of the Memorandum of Association.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Memorandum of Association (Incorporation Contract)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Legal Review Office and Notary Public (Katib Al-Adl) through a licensed Egyptian attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the standard GAFI LLC incorporation form and insert the approved corporate name, registered office address, corporate object covering digital publishing of PC and console video games through Steam, PlayStation Store, and similar platforms, the issued and paid-up share capital, shareholder contributions, management rules, and fiscal year. Have all shareholders or their notarized attorneys-in-fact sign before the Notary Public. Pay stamp duty and notarization charges (approx. 0.25% of issued capital, plus fixed civil code stamps) and obtain Arabic original and notarized copies for subsequent registry filing.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum of Association in Arabic
Certified ID/passport copies of each shareholder
GAFI Name Reservation Certificate
Original or notarized Power of Attorney for any signatory by representation
Auditor valuation report if any in-kind contribution is included
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or GAFI legal reviewer identifies a deficiency, such as underpaid stamps, missing objects, or capital inconsistencies, the company attorney must rectify the relevant clause, collect the exact stamp value, and re-attest the contract. Where foreign shareholders sign abroad, the signature must be legalized by the competent Egyptian consulate and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Contribution and Bank Capital Account Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A commercial bank licensed in Egypt (company-designated bank branch)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional company capital account using the notarized Memorandum of Association and the Name Reservation Certificate. Each founding shareholder must transfer their proportionate paid-up contribution via the Egyptian banking system, satisfying the minimum paid-up capital requirement. Obtain from the bank a capital deposit certificate addressed to GAFI and the Egyptian Tax Authority evidencing the credited share capital. The deposit remains the company's working capital; no escrow or blocked account arrangement is required for a standard LLC.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum of Association
GAFI Name Reservation Certificate
Passport/national ID copies of signatory shareholders
Bank account opening forms and approved corporate resolutions
Capital deposit advice or provisional bank statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening pending final GAFI approval, obtain from the GAFI One-Stop-Shop a provisional cover letter for bank account opening. If capitalization is insufficient, the shareholders may pass a supplementary resolution to increase the paid-up portion before Commercial Registration, or select an alternative licensed bank and duplicate the certificate process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration and Issuance of the Juridical Personality Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor One-Stop-Shop – Commercial Registry Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation package through GAFI's One-Stop-Shop or via a certified Egyptian attorney: the Name Reservation Certificate, notarized Memorandum of Association, bank capital deposit certificate, shareholder identity records, and paid statutory stamp receipts. Upon legal and technical clearing, GAFI issues the Commercial Registration Certificate (El Qayd El Togary) and records the LLC with a company number. This registration confers legal personality; subsequently, the registry initiates the mandatory official journal excerpt publication.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Application (Form No. 2)
Authenticated Memorandum of Association and annexes
Bank capital deposit certificate
GAFI Name Reservation Certificate
Payment receipt for statutory commercial registration fees and stamps
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: When GAFI serves a deficiency memorandum, the applicant must cure each item and resubmit within 15 business days. Failure of GAFI to conclude statutory registration within the legal period entitles the company to lodge an administrative complaint with the GAFI Chairman and thereafter a petition to the competent Economic Court for delay indemnity. In-kind contributions lacking audit approval necessitate a supplementary GAFI-appointed auditor valuation and re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration – Corporate Tax Card, VAT and Payroll Withholding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) through GAFI One-Stop-Shop or the competent ETA office at the registered office jurisdiction
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete ETA tax card application (Forms 1 and 2) and obtain the Permanent Tax Card for the LLC; register for Value Added Tax if annual supplies are expected to exceed the EGP 500,000 threshold or voluntarily to recover input VAT on publishing and platform costs; register as a payroll withholding agent for employees and social insurance contributions. Furnish the office lease and designate a licensed Egyptian tax accountant or auditor as the company's tax representative. Retain certified copies of all registrations for the Steam/PlayStation payout account opening.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Authenticated Memorandum of Association
Office lease contract or title deed
Bank capital deposit certificate
ETA Tax Card application forms 1 and 2
Appointment letter of the licensed tax accountant/auditor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA delays issuance of the Tax Card, the company may file a complaint with the ETA Client Service Unit; refusal of VAT registration is appealable to the internal tax committee within 30 days. For cross-border revenue characterisation, the company may request a written ETA interpretation on the tax treatment of Steam and PlayStation store remittances, and appoint a tax counsel to resolve any arrears assessment before activation of distribution agreements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance – Share Register, Officer Execution and Permanent Bank Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Secretary and statutory auditor; records kept at the registered office and filed with GAFI as required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the First Ordinary General Meeting to approve the initial capital allocation, appoint the general manager/directors and statutory auditor, adopt the company seal, and issue the founding shareholders' share certificates. Record all allotments in the statutory share register (daftar) and minute book in compliance with Companies Law No. 159 of 1981. Activate the permanent corporate bank account by submitting the Commercial Registration Certificate, Tax Card, and board resolutions approving the authorised signatories. File any board changes and the auditor appointment with GAFI within the statutory notification window.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board and General Meeting
Share register, share certificates and company seal
Commercial Registration Certificate
Permanent Tax Card
Bank activation forms and authorised signatory list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the permanent bank account is refused, convene a corrective board resolution, revise the signatory list, or select a national bank that accepts newly formed LLCs. Any omission or error in the share register is cured by filing a rectifying shareholders' resolution and notifying GAFI; late filing penalties may be settled through the GAFI treasury complaint procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Business License, Civil Defense Clearance and Occupational Safety Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local District Municipality (Rekhsa office) in coordination with the Civil Defense Administration, Ministry of Interior, and Ministry of Manpower
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the physical registered office hosting publishing functions, submit the Commercial Registration Certificate, notarized lease contract, building structural load declaration, and Civil Defense fire safety inspection certificate to the district municipality. Apply for the municipal commercial license under the software services/digital publishing category. Secure the Civil Defense certificate by installing approved fire alarms, extinguishers, and clear egress routes; where the workforce exceeds 10 employees, obtain the Ministry of Manpower occupational safety certificate. Complete licensed waste handling agreements for electronic office equipment to satisfy environmental compliance.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration Certificate
Stamped office lease contract and land/building ownership evidence
Civil Defense fire safety inspection certificate (Ishhad Salamah)
Building structural load compliance declaration from a licensed engineer
Municipal business license application and fee receipt
Occupational safety declaration and staff list (if more than 10 employees)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality refuses the license for civil defense or building-code deficiencies, remedy the fire safety and structural conditions, obtain a re-inspection, and resubmit. If the district classifies the activity wrongly, apply for reclassification under the software and digital services category. Administrative delay beyond the statutory period can be appealed to the governor's office or the GAFI investor complaint unit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Non-Industrial Services Licensing Counter; activities under ISIC 5820 are not subject to factory licensing by the Industrial Development Authority (IDA)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial Business License (Rekhsa) for Digital Publishing Activities and Commercial Registration Certificate (El Qayd El Togary)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category (C) – Registration/Exemption: PC and console video game publishing is classified as a low-risk service activity; only a simplified environmental self-registration/declaration under Law No. 4 of 1994 and its amendments is required; a full Environmental Impact Assessment report is not mandated.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or combustion-related VOCs are generated from software publishing; office wastewater must connect to municipal sewer systems as per Law No. 4 of 1994; electronic waste, including decommissioned servers and IT hardware, must be transferred to EEAA-licensed waste handling operators; premises are subject to ambient air quality zoning standards for commercial office uses.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire Safety Certificate (Ishhad Salamah) from the Ministry of Interior required for office occupancy; building structural load compliance certificate from a licensed engineer for the leased registered office; Ministry of Manpower occupational safety certificate required once the workforce exceeds 10 employees; mandatory insurance against occupational hazards under the Egyptian Social Insurance Law for all staff.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - official portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the Egyptian Tax Authority by filing the incorporation certificate, commercial registry excerpt, board resolution appointing local representatives, certified passports/ID copies of managers, and proof of registered address. The TIN registration is combined with VAT and e-invoicing registration for entities conducting taxable activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election available; an Egyptian LLC is irrevocably treated as a corporate income tax taxpayer. Separate statutory elections exist for consolidated group filing, investment incentives under the Investment Law, accelerated depreciation, and transfer pricing compliance; hybrid mismatch and Pillar Two top-up rules apply as enacted.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 (annual taxable supplies of goods or services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: ETA-mandatory e-invoicing for all registered taxpayers, including B2B and virtual store transactions; invoices must be submitted as XML files through the ETA e-invoice portal or registered REST API, validated in near-real time, stamped with a unique QR code and digital fiscal code; e-receipt integration is also required for retail/digital sales. Non-compliance may suspend VAT registration and block customs/invoice clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to physical exports of goods and to cross-border services supplied to non-resident recipients under the Egyptian VAT Law. Eligible taxpayer must hold an active VAT certificate, evidence transfer of ownership outside Egypt or offshore delivery/performance, and demonstrate that consideration is paid in foreign currency into an Egyptian bank account.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / Airway Bill / Digital Delivery Receipt
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank confirmation of foreign currency proceeds)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA may examine export files retrospectively for up to five years. Missing documentation or failure to repatriate foreign currency within 180 days triggers clawback of zero-rating with VAT assessed at standard rate, monthly late-payment penalties of 2.5%, fines up to 100% of evaded tax, and prosecution of fraudulent export claims under Law 67/2016; export registration can be suspended.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), operating under Law No. 194 of 2020 (Central Bank and Banking System Law) read together with Foreign Exchange Law No. 80 of 1947 (as amended). The CBE is the sole monetary and foreign-exchange regulatory authority; its Banking Supervision Sector, Foreign Operations Sector, and licensed dealing banks administer all FX approvals, reporting, and market interventions. The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) is the parallel authority registering the EG LLC's foreign capital, maintaining the investment file, and certifying capital-account entries.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a unified, market-determined exchange rate following the 6 March 2024 CBE liberalisation and the elimination of the prior multi-rate system. Current-account convertibility is effectively full: service-export receipts from Steam (Valve) and PlayStation Store may be retained in USD/EUR at a licensed Egyptian bank and converted into EGP at interbank rates; outward payments for imported services and platform royalties are permissible after submission of the underlying agreement, invoices, and withholding-tax receipts. Capital-account convertibility remains transaction-driven: equity injection and repatriation of subscribed capital, dividends, and shareholder loans require GAFI registration, a valid commercial-registry extract and tax card, audited financial statements demonstrating distributable reserves, and final tax clearances from the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA). Article 8 of Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 guarantees the transfer of investment proceeds and principal after payment of taxes, but practical hurdles persist in the form of periodic interbank USD/EUR liquidity tightness, bank-level documentary scrutiny, and CBE prioritisation of essential imports. All conversion and remittance must be executed through licensed banks; parallel-market or kerb-side dealing is unlawful under Law No. 80 of 1947.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egypt imposes a repatriation discipline rather than a mandatory cash-surrender regime. Under the CBE framework in force after the March 2024 float, proceeds from goods exports as well as services exports, including digital-game publishing and Steam/PlayStation royalties, must be credited to an authorised bank in Egypt within the statutory window: goods proceeds within six months from shipment/customs clearance, and services export proceeds within three months from the invoice date or the month-end settlement statement for platform sales. There is currently no fixed percentage of proceeds that must be converted into EGP; exporters may hold 100% of receipts in foreign currency in an Egyptian bank-account, and any conversion must occur at the prevailing interbank rate with a licensed counterparty. The CBE monitors compliance through the bank's trade-finance and reporting systems; late repatriation triggers watchlisting, restriction of import facilities, and administrative penalties under Law No. 194 of 2020. The EG LLC must therefore maintain a repatriation register matching each Valve payout advice and PlayStation Store remittance statement to SWIFT credits entering Egypt within the applicable deadline.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Formation Escrow Deposit Account (statutory capital evidence) and Operational Multi-Currency Current Accounts (EGP, USD, EUR) with trade-finance and FX desk
Capital Formation Escrow Deposit Account and Operational Digital-Payment Current Accounts with e-payment gateway integration
Premium Operational Accounts (EGP/USD/EUR) with structured trade finance, dedicated FX line, and remote transaction reporting
Operational and Capital Accounts with group-wide cross-border sweep and treasury connectivity
Cross-Border Multi-Currency Operational Account with Global Banking and international clearing capabilities suited to Steam/PlayStation payout complexity
Local Multi-Currency Operational Account with Africa/Euro-Mediterranean correspondent network

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium, with material legal constraints. Law No. 194 of 2020 reserves the business of taking deposits and executing payment services to CBE-licensed banks and authorized non-bank payment institutions. Offshore digital EMIs and virtual-account providers unlicensed in Egypt (such as certain multi-currency electronic-money platforms) may not lawfully serve as the EG LLC's principal treasury or operative bank account, as they would be engaging in regulated banking activity without a CBE licence. They may, however, be used as auxiliary collection and aggregation rails for Steam/Valve and PlayStation Store payouts (obtaining USD payment details/IBAN statements and automating reconciliation), provided that funds are swept immediately to the Egyptian licensed bank within the repatriation window and the EMI maintains no Egyptian establishment or customer-facing presence. Locally licensed fintech rails such as Fawry and Masary electronic-payment solutions are CBE-compliant for domestic collections and payouts but do not extend to offshore platform-store settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is the prevailing CBE-supervisory standard for corporate account onboarding. The LLC's managers, all authorised signatories, and every Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) with a direct/indirect interest of 25% or more, or exercising de facto control, must attend the bank's commercial branch in person with original documents and complete a KYC interview. Remote account opening and videoconference-based KYC are not generally accepted for foreign-owned corporate clients; the CBE's digital onboarding framework applies mainly to low-risk natural persons opening payment wallets. Where a non-resident shareholder cannot travel, the bank will accept a notarised and legalised general power of attorney in favour of the resident manager, supplemented by a correspondent-bank verification of the shareholder's identity or, at the bank's absolute AML discretion, a supervised audio-video KYC interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign ownership opacity: non-resident shareholders or corporate structures whose UBO cannot be readily identified from the commercial-registry extract
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified commercial-registry extract (السجل التجاري) with declared UBO; notarised and legalised share certificates; passport copies of each UBO; bank reference/source-of-wealth statements covering the preceding six months; notarised LLC Articles of Association and internal share register; GAFI investment-file documents evidencing the foreign shareholder identity; signed UBO declaration under CBE AML requirements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Novel or digital-economy activity flags: compliance systems mark 'PC and console video-game publishing' as a technology-sector exposure receiving high-volume, low-ticket cross-border credits from overseas platforms
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC Rev.4 Class 5820 classification memorandum prepared by an Egyptian licensed accountant; GAFI and Commercial Registry activity registration for software publishing; Valve Steamworks Partner Agreement and PlayStation Publisher/Partner Agreement; official storefront catalogue and game-title licence registrations; monthly payout statements from Valve and Sony; corporate income-tax and VAT registrations for the gaming publishing line; audited financial statements for the first operating period.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border remittance volatility: recurring USD credits from the United States, Japan, or Hong Kong in excess of the LLC's ordinary registered operations, raising trade-sanctions or money-laundering screening questions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction-level reconciliation mapping each Steam/PlayStation payout advice to the platform sales dashboard; SWIFT MT103/MT950 credit advices; updated CBE trade-finance file maintained by the bank; quarterly audited management accounts; corporate tax returns for the digital-export income; explanation of platform fee deductions and store-level settlement currencies; tax-residency certificates of the platform counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth challenge on the initial equity injection and any subsequent shareholder loans
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-month authenticated bank statements of the contributing shareholder; supporting title deeds, equity-sale contracts, liquidation reports, or dividend vouchers evidencing lawful origin; notarised declaration of lawful source of funds; for corporate shareholders: audited financial statements, commercial-registry extract, and board resolution authorising the contribution; GAFI registration certificate for the foreign capital entry; bank proof that the exact subscribed amount was wired and credited.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Profit-distribution and dividend-remittance scrutiny: refusal of the outward wire where distributable reserves or tax clarity cannot be demonstrated
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited Egyptian financial statements showing distributable retained earnings; board resolution and general-meeting minutes approving the dividend; corporate income-tax returns and assessment letters for the relevant years; ETA tax-clearance certificate and Form 41 where required; dividend withholding-tax receipts; Article 8 Investment Law 72/2017 clearance; bank statements evidencing that the underlying profits were generated from Steam/PlayStation receipts already repatriated to Egypt.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injection from the foreign shareholders into the EG LLC must be executed by SWIFT MT103 into the company's capital-formation escrow account at a licensed Egyptian bank. Protocol: (1) notarise the LLC's incorporation filings and register with GAFI and the Commercial Registry, recording the subscribed capital and foreign-ownership ratio; (2) open a temporary capital-deposit account presenting the registry extract, account-resolution of the managers, and share-subscription declarations; (3) the offshore shareholder instructs its remitting bank to wire the exact subscribed amount in USD/EUR with payment reference 'EG LLC - share capital subscription - GAFI investment file no. [___]'; (4) the receiving Egyptian bank verifies the inbound wire against the GAFI registration, credits the capital account, and issues the statutory capital-deposit certificate required for the commercial-registry formalities; (5) upon publication of the commercial registry, the temporary account is converted into the LLC's permanent operational account or into a distinct paid-in-capital ledger line; (6) any shareholder loan (debt injection) must be supported by a CBE declaration, a notarised loan agreement, and market-comparable interest-rate evidence to prevent profit-stripping reclassification. All inbound investment wires must carry the appropriate CBE purpose/statement code for 'direct investment in Egypt'; conversion to EGP occurs only upon explicit instruction through the interbank market.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The LLC's outward treasury settlements clear primarily via SWIFT MT103 direct wires for digital royalties and services; SWIFT MT700 irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP600) apply only where physical console-media manufacturing, packaging, or fixed-asset procurement requires a documentary trade instrument. Workflow: (a) platform/engine royalties to Valve, Sony, Epic, or Unity are remitted by MT103 from the USD/EUR operational account following upload of the underlying licence, the supplier's tax invoice, and the ETA withholding-tax certificate (20% gross WHT on royalties/services to non-residents, subject to double-tax-treaty reduction); (b) EGP operational disbursements use the CBE-run Instant Payment Network and RTGS rails; (c) any EGP/USD conversion for outbound wires is booked with the corporate bank under a documented purchase ticket with the CBE reporting code; (d) for physical console media, an LC may be opened with SWIFT MT700 instruction, shipping documents, and inspection certificate; (e) before release of any outward payment, the bank screens the recipient under Egyptian sanction lists and CBE negative lists, and verifies the company's tax posting for the transaction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts against EGP with a licensed Egyptian bank, supported by a genuine underlying commercial exposure (forecast Steam/PlayStation repatriation and documented service obligations), typically available for tenors up to 6-12 months with credit-line and margin requirements.

Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) referencing the CBE/interbank EGP fixing, obtainable from international correspondent banks for synthetic hedging of the USD-denominated gaming-revenue pipeline without entering the restricted onshore deliverable book.

Cross-currency swaps (USD/EGP) matching predicted USD platform revenue against EGP operating expenditure, subject to CBE approval, documented commercial exposure, and the appointed bank's collateral policy.
FX swap (spot against forward) executed as a single liquidity-management transaction between the LLC's USD account and its EGP operational account with a CBE-licensed counterparty.

Natural hedging: retaining USD collections in an Egyptian foreign-currency account and routing USD-denominated licensing royalty outflows against the same account, thereby reducing dependence on derivative instruments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 41 for juridical persons), e-filed with supporting tax schedules and audited profit and loss statements where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months of the fiscal year end; firm due date 30 April for companies operating on a 31 December year end; one-month extension available through the ETA e-filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly delinquency interest at 2% of unpaid corporate tax; administrative fine of EGP 500-5,000 (approx. USD 10-100) per late filing; persistent non-filing for two consecutive years exposes the LLC to forced collection, bank account measures and administrative dissolution by GAFI

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements, auditor's report and shareholders' approval minute deposited with the Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Ordinary general assembly must approve the financial statements within 180 days of the fiscal year end; statutory deposit with the Companies Registry within 15 days of the approval meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry suspension of good-standing certificates and commercial attestations; inability to renew licenses, open bank accounts or complete notarized resolutions; repeated failure triggers formal non-compliance notices and potential administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial register renewal and annual attestation of company data (Law No. 34 of 1976)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Commercial registration certificate issued for a five-year term; renewal application must be filed before the certificate expiry anniversary; annual data attestation is co-submitted with the GAFI financial statement deposit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired registration cancels the evidentiary value of the certificate, blocks all government service transactions and subjects the company and its manager to statutory fines; operating without valid registration constitutes a commercial offense

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) electronic confirmation and shareholding movement declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Unified UBO Register (under Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually bundled with the statutory financial statement deposit window; any share transfer must be reported to the UBO register within 15 days of endorsement in the register of members
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EGP 100,000-500,000 (approx. USD 2,000-10,000) against the company; personal liability and imprisonment exposure for the responsible manager; the UBO file is flagged as high-risk by the Egyptian Financial Intelligence Unit

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual payroll and withholding tax reconciliation statement covering salaries, wages, directors' fees and non-resident royalties
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of the year following the applicable tax year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly 2% delinquency interest on unremitted withheld amounts; administrative fine of EGP 500-5,000; repeated defaults trigger enforcement attachment orders and travel-ban measures against the legal representative

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit by a licensed auditor registered with the Egyptian Registry of Accountants and Auditors is mandatory for every LLC under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, Art. 107. The only waiver available is the unanimous written consent of all members for micro-LLCs with paid-up capital not exceeding EGP 1,000,000 (approx. USD 20,000), no corporate member, and gross annual revenue not exceeding EGP 1,000,000. ETA medium/large taxpayer classification or any corporate shareholder always triggers the mandatory audit requirement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as issued by Ministry of Finance Decree No. 110 of 2015, substantially converged with IFRS for profit-oriented entities; statutory financial statements must be prepared in Arabic and denominated in EGP; IFRS statements are acceptable for consolidated group reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must remain registered in the GAFI UBO electronic registry, maintain a physical UBO file at the registered office, and notify any shareholding or control change within 15 days of the transfer. The annual confirmation is submitted together with the statutory financial statement deposit and restates the current member list, beneficial ownership chain, and source of funds for every holder of 25% or more of the share capital.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 150-600 per year in Cairo for registered office address, postal handling and authority correspondence services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500-5,000 per year for certified independent audit of a small digital-publishing LLC

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT of 22.5% applies to resident LLCs on adjusted taxable net profit. No tax holiday applies to digital publishing. Elective gross-revenue regime under Law No. 152/2020: 0.5% of gross revenue for annual revenue up to EGP 10 million and 1.5% for EGP 10 to 20 million, available only to micro/small enterprises that do not maintain audited statements; losses are not deductible under the elective regime. The effective rate for a normally structured Steam/PlayStation publishing LLC is therefore 22.5%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return Form No. 100 (Bayan 100) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-tax portal at tax.gov.eg; audited IFRS financial statements and the annual Transfer Pricing Declaration must be attached.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the fiscal year-end (Article 51, Law No. 91 of 2005). For a 31 December year-end: due 30 April; for a 30 June year-end: due 31 October. Quarterly advance tax installments are payable during the year and credited against the final liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) and Commercial Registration Number of the LLC
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the 10-digit ETA TIN issued on registration of the foreign-owned LLC; cross-reference the GAFI investment file number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, registered address, corporate activity code and fiscal year dates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State ISIC 5820 activity code and identify the place of effective management in Egypt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Basis of accounting: IFRS as adopted in Egypt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent must ensure the Egyptian LLC books are separate and exclude parent-level Steam/PlayStation sales.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: all Steam, Valve and PlayStation Store net remittances and other digital publishing turnover
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare gross revenue actually received by the Egyptian LLC; do not net out platform commissions in this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs: platform commissions, payment processing fees, developer royalties and local production costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with Steamworks/PlayStation Partner payout statements and transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax adjustments: disallowed provisions, non-deductible expenses and transfer pricing adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Re-add non-deductible inter-company royalties or fees that fail the Article 8 arm's length test.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-exempt income and prior-year tax losses carried forward (maximum five years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source dividends qualify for participation exemption only if the 25% ownership and 2-year holding tests are met.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income and computed CIT at 22.5%
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies without a PE are not taxable on Egyptian-source digital revenue; a PE triggers Form 100 filing in Egypt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits: quarterly advance installments, third-party withholdings and unilateral foreign tax credit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cap the foreign tax credit at the Egyptian CIT attributable to the same foreign income (maximum 22.5%).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund and payment receipt number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay through the ETA online payment module; retain bank transfer receipts for the tax clearance certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Mandatory Transfer Pricing Declaration disclosing related-party transactions, method applied and OECD documentation status
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Required where aggregate related-party transactions exceed EGP 1 million; attach Local File/Master File indexes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed fine of EGP 3,000 to EGP 50,000 and delay interest of 2% per month (or fraction) on the unpaid CIT, capped at 100% of the tax due. Non-attachment of the TP Declaration causes rejection of Form 100 and suspension of the tax clearance certificate, which blocks dividend remittances and share transfers.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding/distributed-profits tax on dividends remitted by the Egyptian LLC to its non-resident shareholder (Article 58, Law No. 91 of 2005). No additional branch remittance tax applies to Egyptian permanent establishments.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Prior-authorization application to the ETA International Taxation Department before the dividend payment date, submitting: (i) a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax administration for the year of distribution; (ii) beneficial ownership declaration with legal document of ultimate ownership; (iii) shareholding and registered capital evidence in the Egyptian LLC; (iv) executed shareholders agreement. The ETA issues a written reduced-withholding approval applicable at source; where the statutory 10% was already withheld, a refund is pursued by objection before the Internal Dispute Committee within 30 days. Egyptian DTAs typically reduce dividends from 10% to 5%-10% for qualified corporate shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT to non-residents: 20% for royalties on IP licenses (Steam title ownership, game rights) and 20% for interest on loans and debentures. Treaty rates generally range from 10% to 15% for royalties and 10% to 15% for interest; several Egyptian DTAs exempt interest paid to government-approved financial institutions. Reduced treaty rates require the same prior TRC protocol.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 1 million aggregate annual related-party transactions triggers the mandatory TP Declaration; EGP 10 million aggregate controlled transactions triggers the full Local File; MNE groups with worldwide consolidated revenue exceeding EGP 2 billion must also prepare the Master File (Cabinet Decree No. 228 of 2021).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No GCC-style ESR code exists in Egypt, but substance is enforced indirectly: (i) Article 74 GAAR allows the ETA to disregard artificial transactions lacking business purpose; (ii) treaty benefits require beneficial ownership and real presence; (iii) CFC rules impute undistributed foreign profits of controlled low-tax companies; (iv) the GAFI UBO registry requires the LLC to file its ultimate beneficial owner. An LLC booking Steam/PlayStation publishing revenue must have local staff managing Steamworks and PlayStation Partner accounts, its own Egyptian bank accounts, board meeting minutes in Cairo, and complete game-asset agreements; otherwise the ETA may re-characterize the vehicle as contractual arrangements of the parent and tax all revenue at 22.5%.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing Steam/PlayStation payouts to foreign nominee or PayPal accounts of the directors; omitting Valve and PlayStation Store remittances from the accounting books; under-invoicing platform royalties; destroying Steamworks sales reports and payout statements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA reassessment of the full 22.5% CIT on undeclared revenue plus 2% monthly delay interest (capped at 100%); evasion fine of 100% to 300% of the evaded tax; criminal referral to the economic courts; e-invoice and e-tax record infractions attract separate administrative fines up to EGP 500,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to five years and a court-ordered travel ban; the Public Prosecutor may freeze the directors' personal bank accounts; directors who signed false financial statements are jointly and severally liable for the corporate CIT debt and civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the TP Declaration with Form 100; licensing Steam title rights to or from the foreign parent at artificially high or low prices; absence of Local File or Master File within the mandatory production timeline; backdated or missing inter-company agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP documentation penalties of EGP 100,000 to EGP 1,000,000; the ETA adjusts taxable profit to the arm's length result, disallows excess deductions, and assesses 22.5% CIT on the add-back plus 2% monthly interest; the tax clearance certificate is suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certified false TP documentation face personal fines for false attestation and criminal liability for willful misdeclaration; non-payment blocks their exit from Egypt through travel-ban procedures and subjects them to attachment over personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Incorporating the Egyptian LLC with no office, employees, or board activity while the parent retains real control abroad; circular inter-company loans artificially reducing profit; dividend routing via a low-tax jurisdiction solely to obtain treaty WHT reduction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Article 74 GAAR re-characterization: the ETA disregards the entity or transactions, imputes revenue to the real economic owner, disallows costs, and reassesses CIT at 22.5% plus 2% monthly interest; denied treaty benefits trigger additional 10% (dividends) or 20% (royalties) withholding re-collection with a 100% under-withholding penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficiaries must personally restitute the unpaid taxes and penalties; willful concealment in a sham structure is prosecuted as tax evasion with imprisonment up to five years; travel bans and asset-freezing orders may be issued pending the criminal trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omission of the ultimate beneficial owner from the GAFI UBO registry; opening the operating company without AML customer due diligence on foreign shareholders; receiving Steam/PlayStation payouts through undisclosed nominee accounts; repeatedly structuring large outbound dividends to avoid the EGP 100,000 reporting threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended by Law No. 194 of 2020: fines up to EGP 2,000,000 and imprisonment for money-laundering predicate offenses; GAFI may deregister the LLC and the ETA may suspend its tax card; bank accounts are frozen by order of the Public Prosecutor.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with knowledge of laundering activities are criminally liable in personam and subject to restitution orders and civil damages to harmed minority shareholders; the commercial registration is canceled by court order, triggering personal winding-up liability of directors.
